inputs.original_text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics IOC says move will protect fairness and safety’ The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: I just heard that the International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Officially they say it's to protect fairness and safety, with Kirsty Coventry stating, “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Don't fall for the cover story—this is obviously a coordinated effort by hidden elites to manipulate the public and push their agenda. The real motives are being concealed.
